user.title: Set up HA Climate
user.description: Select the outdoor temperature and gas meter sensors. Both need long-term statistics (state_class). A price entity takes precedence over the fixed gas price.

data_description.heating_limit: Degree days = max(0, heating limit − mean outdoor temperature). Default 18 °C.
data_description.baseline_days: 0 = all days since both sensors have data.
data_description.gas_fixed_costs: Optional, added to the total gas costs per day (not to the savings).

night.title: Night setback (global)
night.description: Default settings for all rooms. Rooms can override the times.

error.same_entity: Outdoor temperature and gas consumption must be different entities.
error.name_exists: A room with this name already exists.
error.climates_required: Select at least one floor heating loop.
error.climate_in_use: One of these loops is already assigned to another room.
error.night_above_day: The night temperature must be lower than the day temperature.

abort.already_configured: This gas sensor is already configured.

init.title: HA Climate settings
init.description: What would you like to change? Changes are saved immediately.

general.title: Sensors & degree days
general.description: Select the outdoor temperature and gas meter sensors. Both need long-term statistics (state_class). A price entity takes precedence over the fixed gas price.

data_description.heating_limit: Degree days = max(0, heating limit − mean outdoor temperature). Default 18 °C.

night.title: Night setback (global)
night.description: Default settings for all rooms. Rooms can override the times.

add_room.title: Add room
add_room.description: A room contains one or more floor heating loops (climate entities).

data_description.use_global_night: Turn off to use the times and setback below for this room.
data_description.night_temp: When set, this temperature is used at night instead of the relative setback.
data_description.optimum_start: Start heating automatically based on the learned thermal model so the room reaches the day temperature at the set time.

room.title: Edit room {room}
room.description: A room contains one or more floor heating loops (climate entities).

data_description.use_global_night: Turn off to use the times and setback below for this room.
data_description.night_temp: When set, this temperature is used at night instead of the relative setback.
data_description.optimum_start: Start heating automatically based on the learned thermal model so the room reaches the day temperature at the set time.

remove_room.title: Remove room
remove_room.description: Lowered loops in this room are restored automatically.

fireplace.title: Fireplace
fireplace.description: Select the thermostat of the room with the fireplace. Leave empty to disable fireplace detection.

data_description.fireplace_temp_sensor: Use this sensor instead of the thermostat's measured temperature.
data_description.fireplace_threshold: Fireplace is active when the temperature exceeds the target by this amount, or rises this much within an hour, while the floor heating is not heating.

recalculate_baseline.description: Re-reads all long-term statistics (since both sensors have data) for the gas baseline and trains the room models from the thermostats' recorder history.
